info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Underwritings-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Underwriting Retrieval API provides a comprehensive mechanism for accessing underwriting details associated with mortgage loans. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of underwriting records, enabling lenders and mortgage brokers to assess the status and details of loan applications. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and loan processors who require insights into underwriting processes to make informed decisions. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can streamline their workflows and enhance their operational efficiency.

get.description: Fetch details regarding the underwriting status of loans, including necessary assessments and decisions made during the loan evaluation process.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating the underwriting process of a loan, containing all necessary parameters to evaluate the loan application.

200.description: Request completed successfully; underwriting details retrieved.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsRequest.description: Represents the JSON request body for the GET operation related to loan underwriting.

status.description: Indicates if the underwriting operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the transaction.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the underwriting process.

state.description: The current state of the underwriting process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the underwriting request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message detailing the result of the underwriting operation.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsResponse_2.description: Schema representing the response for the underwriting operation of loans.

createdBy.description: The username or ID of the person or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the entry was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit information related to the underwriting operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value helps in assessing the performance of the API.
